Marissa — attaching our redlines for the MSA and the Order Form. Legal pushed back on Redwood's standard publicity/reference clause; the asks are: 

- No press release without NovaPromo sign-off (we'd need a 7-business-day review window).
- Logo use limited to product pages and case studies; must use the provided asset pack.
- No customer quotes or metrics without explicit written approval for each instance.

I've attached the PDF with inline redline comments (Novapromo_MSA_Redlines_20270110.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept these limits or propose a middle ground? We'd like to get the Order Form signed this week if possible.

Hi Sophie — appreciate the quick turnaround and the detailed notes. We're excited to partner with NovaPromo and want to keep things simple so legal can sign off without blocking go-live. A couple of suggestions that usually work for both sides: 

- Press releases: Redwood is fine with prior written approval; can we standardize on a 5-business-day review window rather than 7? That keeps momentum for joint announcements.
- Logo use: happy to limit to the approved logo pack and product pages/case studies. We'll add a clause requiring use of assets from NovaPromo_Logo_Pack.zip and an obligation to remove outdated assets on request.
- Customer quotes/metrics: we can accept a per-instance written approval requirement, but propose an explicit approval process: NovaPromo reviews within 3 business days; if no response we treat as approved (unless you mark "hold").

If that sounds reasonable I can circulate the updated Order Form language and ask Legal to route for countersignature. 

Also copying Rishi and Karthik for any legal/redline feedback. 

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
m: +1 206-555-0147

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form redlines (publicity & logo use)

Looping in suggested language. TL;DR — Marissa's compromise is acceptable; keep explicit approvals short and preserve our right to reference the customer in sales motions (non-press marketing). Proposed edits to insert into Order Form: 

1) Publicity: "Supplier may reference Customer's name and logo in Supplier's marketing and sales materials (including website and case studies) provided Supplier uses only assets supplied by Customer and does not issue press releases or public announcements regarding the Agreement without Customer's prior written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld and shall be provided within five (5) business days of receipt of the proposed announcement."

2) Quotes/Metrics: "Customer shall provide written approval for any Customer-specific quote or metric. Customer shall respond within three (3) business days; absence of response shall constitute approval unless Customer has indicated 'hold' in writing prior to the end of the three-day period."

3) Logo assets/termination: "On termination of the Agreement Customer may require Supplier to cease use of Customer logos within thirty (30) days of written notice and Supplier will remove assets from public pages within that period."

Recommend we send this version to Sophie and request a countersign. If NovaPromo insists on seven days for press approvals, we can accept as long as we get an explicit speedy approval path for co-marketing timelines.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
